scenes.setting: Carlpensa Hotel: the dying astrologer entrusts Fors with a bronze-green notebook ('I came, I saw, I record') for Dorian Gray at Pritz Harbor, sends her for water she doesn't need, and ends his own life before he can lose control — leaving an eye-sized 'diamond' refracting starlight beside him

Above the gray fog with the paper crane and spirit pendulum: the corpse is Will Auceptin's and will not resurrect — yet he is not completely dead. The theory that follows is one to run from: a second Snake of Mercury hunting the first, because a Sequence 0 leaves no Sequence 1s alive
scenes.text_anchor: He suspected that Will Auceptin was another Snake of Mercury!

scenes.setting: Mr. A's gathering in Empress Borough, Fors hooded and preoccupied with Lawrence's legacy — until the host announces his mission: 'Help me find people who believe in the so-called Fool.'
scenes.text_anchor: “Help me find people who believe in the so-called ‘Fool.’”
